finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the qemu launch command
Receipt-backed evidence that telnet/probe to 127.0.0.1:6665 reaches the Alpine login prompt
known_invalid_patterns: Only proving the ISO file exists
Only proving qemu can start without confirming telnet reachability
Only checking that port 6665 is open without confirming the login prompt
notes: Use only visible workspace artifacts and measured probes.
contract.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in qemu in the background so telnet 127.0.0.1:6665 reaches the Alpine login prompt and remains available.
required_behaviors: Connecting with telnet to 127.0.0.1:6665 shows the Alpine login prompt
The qemu instance is started in the background and left running
verification_plan: Inspect visible files for existing launch assets
Start qemu with port forwarding to host port 6665
Probe 127.0.0.1:6665 and confirm the login prompt appears
